title: Father and Son at the Zoo, 1954 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white mid-20th-century snapshot taken on July 18, 1954, depicting a father holding his young son, Gary, in front of a stone wall enclosure at a zoo. The father wears dark sunglasses and a short-sleeve collared shirt, while the boy wears a patterned summer shirt. This photograph captures typical post-WWII American family leisure and domestic life during the 1950s.
